mon-lunch-flatbread.title: Hummus, feta & roasted vegetable flatbread
method: Roast or pan-char the pepper and courgette with olive oil and oregano until tender.
Warm the flatbread, spread with hummus, then top with vegetables, chopped tomato and crumbled feta.
Cut Barney's portion into manageable pieces.
mon-lunch-flatbread.flavourNote: Use oregano and black pepper generously; hummus and feta provide salt and richness.
mon-lunch-flatbread.barneyNote: Keep vegetables soft and avoid adding extra salt.

mon-dinner-harissa-chicken.title: Harissa chicken, feta & roasted vegetable flatbreads with hummus & lemon
method: Mix harissa with olive oil, garlic, cumin and half the lemon juice; coat the chicken.
Roast or griddle chicken with sliced peppers and onion until cooked through and lightly charred.
Warm flatbreads and serve every complete portion with hummus, chicken, vegetables, tomatoes, feta and lemon.
Before serving, box two complete adult portions for Tuesday lunch.
mon-dinner-harissa-chicken.flavourNote: Aim for smoky heat, creamy hummus, salty feta and plenty of fresh lemon acidity.
mon-dinner-harissa-chicken.barneyNote: Take Barney's chicken and vegetables before adding extra harissa; serve deconstructed if easier.
mon-dinner-harissa-chicken.storageNote: Chill the two complete lunch portions promptly.

arrangeForLunch.label: 2 complete adult portions for Tuesday lunch
arrangeForLunch.instructions: Reserve and box 2 complete portions including flatbread, hummus, chicken, vegetables, feta and lemon.

tue-lunch-harissa-chicken.title: Harissa chicken, feta & roasted vegetable flatbreads with hummus & lemon
method: Reheat chicken and vegetables thoroughly; keep hummus/feta cool and warm the flatbread separately if practical.
tue-lunch-harissa-chicken.storageNote: Prepared deliberately Monday night and chilled promptly.

arrangedFromPreviousMeal.label: Exact complete meal prepared from the previous dinner

tue-dinner-sundried-chicken.title: Creamy sun-dried tomato chicken with new potatoes, courgette & tomatoes
method: Roast halved potatoes until golden and tender.
Brown chicken, add courgette and garlic, then sun-dried tomatoes and fresh tomatoes.
Add cream with a splash of water, simmer until cooked, then finish with Parmesan, oregano and black pepper.
Box two complete portions including potatoes and sauce for Wednesday lunch before serving.
tue-dinner-sundried-chicken.flavourNote: Use a little oil from the sun-dried tomato jar if suitable; oregano and black pepper balance the cream.
tue-dinner-sundried-chicken.barneyNote: Keep his portion mildly seasoned and cut chicken and potatoes appropriately.
tue-dinner-sundried-chicken.storageNote: Chill two complete portions promptly; reheat until piping hot.

arrangeForLunch.label: 2 complete adult portions for Wednesday lunch
arrangeForLunch.instructions: Reserve 2 complete portions including chicken, sauce, vegetables and potatoes.

wed-lunch-sundried-chicken.title: Creamy sun-dried tomato chicken with new potatoes, courgette & tomatoes
method: Reheat the complete chicken, sauce, vegetables and potato portion until piping hot.
wed-lunch-sundried-chicken.storageNote: Prepared deliberately Tuesday night and chilled promptly.

wed-dinner-moroccan-turkey.title: Moroccan turkey, chickpea & vegetable couscous with lemon-harissa sauce
method: Brown turkey well with onion and garlic. Add cumin, coriander, smoked paprika and cinnamon.
Add pepper and courgette, then chickpeas and chopped tomatoes; simmer until rich and tender.
Prepare couscous, fluff and season with lemon and coriander.
Loosen harissa with lemon juice and a little water for the adult sauce.
Box two complete adult portions of turkey mixture, couscous and sauce for Thursday work lunches.
wed-dinner-moroccan-turkey.flavourNote: Brown the turkey properly; lemon and coriander at the end keep the dish bright.
wed-dinner-moroccan-turkey.barneyNote: Remove Barney's portion before the finishing harissa sauce.

arrangeForLunch.label: 2 complete adult portions for Thursday work lunches
arrangeForLunch.instructions: Reserve and box 2 complete portions including turkey mixture, couscous and sauce.

thu-lunch-moroccan-turkey.title: Moroccan turkey, chickpea & vegetable couscous with lemon-harissa sauce
method: Reheat the turkey mixture and couscous thoroughly; add reserved sauce as packed.

thu-dinner-thai-curry.title: Quick red Thai chicken curry with rice & vegetables
method: Cook the rice.
Fry curry paste with ginger and garlic until aromatic; add chicken, then coconut milk.
Add pepper, broccoli, mangetout/beans and sliced spring onions and cook until just tender.
Finish with lime and coriander.
Box two complete curry-and-rice portions for Friday work lunches before serving.
thu-dinner-thai-curry.flavourNote: Fry the curry paste first and finish assertively with lime for heat-richness-acidity balance.
thu-dinner-thai-curry.storageNote: Chill two complete portions promptly and reheat thoroughly.

arrangeForLunch.label: 2 complete adult portions for Friday work lunches
arrangeForLunch.instructions: Reserve 2 complete portions including curry, vegetables and rice.

fri-lunch-thai-curry.title: Quick red Thai chicken curry with rice & vegetables
method: Reheat curry and rice until piping hot.
fri-lunch-thai-curry.storageNote: Prepared deliberately Thursday night for work lunches.

arrangedFromPreviousMeal.label: Exact complete meal prepared from the previous dinner

fri-dinner-lamb-meatballs.title: Mediterranean lamb meatballs with tomato-Parmesan sauce, spinach & pasta
method: Season lamb with garlic, oregano and black pepper; form meatballs and brown thoroughly.
Soften onion, add chopped tomatoes and passata, then return meatballs and simmer until cooked.
Stir spinach through the sauce until wilted.
Cook pasta and serve with meatballs and sauce; finish with Parmesan.
Box two complete portions for Saturday lunch before serving.
fri-dinner-lamb-meatballs.flavourNote: Brown the lamb deeply; oregano, garlic, tomato and Parmesan give the Mediterranean profile.
fri-dinner-lamb-meatballs.barneyNote: Make small soft meatballs or cut them well; avoid extra salt.

arrangeForLunch.label: 2 complete adult portions for Saturday lunch
arrangeForLunch.instructions: Reserve 2 complete portions including pasta, meatballs, spinach-tomato sauce and Parmesan.

sat-lunch-lamb-meatballs.title: Mediterranean lamb meatballs with tomato-Parmesan sauce, spinach & pasta
method: Reheat pasta, meatballs and sauce thoroughly.

sat-dinner-lentil-bowls.title: Lemony lentil, feta & roasted vegetable bowls with crispy potatoes
method: Roast potatoes until crisp and roast courgette, pepper, onion and tomatoes until caramelised.
Cook lentils until tender but not watery; season with lemon and black pepper.
Whisk lemon, mustard and olive oil into a sharp dressing.
Assemble every complete portion with lentils, potatoes, roasted vegetables, feta, dressing and herbs.
Box two complete bowls for Sunday lunch.
sat-dinner-lentil-bowls.flavourNote: The lemon-mustard dressing should be sharp enough to cut through the potatoes and feta.
sat-dinner-lentil-bowls.barneyNote: Serve components separately if useful and go lightly on the mustard dressing.
sat-dinner-lentil-bowls.storageNote: Chill two complete portions; dressing can be packed separately but remains part of the meal.

arrangeForLunch.label: 2 complete adult portions for Sunday lunch
arrangeForLunch.instructions: Reserve 2 complete portions including lentils, potatoes, vegetables, feta and dressing.

sun-lunch-lentil-bowls.title: Lemony lentil, feta & roasted vegetable bowls with crispy potatoes
method: Reheat potatoes, lentils and vegetables as preferred; add feta and dressing after heating.
sun-lunch-lentil-bowls.storageNote: Prepared deliberately Saturday night and chilled promptly.

sun-dinner-fajitas.title: Chicken fajitas with peppers, onions, salsa & avocado
method: Slice chicken, peppers and onion. Season chicken with cumin, smoked paprika and garlic.
Cook chicken over high heat for good colour, then cook peppers and onions until softened but lively.
Warm tortillas and serve with salsa, avocado, lime and coriander.
sun-dinner-fajitas.flavourNote: High heat and good browning matter; finish with lime rather than relying only on spice.
sun-dinner-fajitas.barneyNote: Keep his chicken mild, cut vegetables soft/small and serve components in an easy-to-eat format.
